description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 识别出的字排成表格时，文字窗口里多一个「复制为表格」，粘进 Excel、WPS 一格一格排好；长截图时盖在选区上的预览不再被截进去，还能拖开（#378）；横向长截图有了英文界面。权限不变。
notes.en: When recognized words stand as a table, Copy as a table pastes them cell by cell into Excel or WPS; the long screenshot's preview over the region is no longer captured and can be dragged aside (#378); the sideways long screenshot has its English texts. Permissions unchanged.
